name: sgs/star-rating
title: SGS Star Rating
description: Star rating display with half-star support and schema.org markup.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Root <div> (render.php get_block_wrapper_attributes, style.css .sgs-star-rating — display:flex hardcoded, no attribute, so no `layer`/arrangement members). No width/height/max-width/border/box-shadow/gap attribute exists on this block — honest gaps. Content-KIND, block-private (D294).

star.label: Star
star._note: SVG glyph fill (render.php:227/244, sgs_colour_value($attributes['starColour'])) — starColour is mapped EXPLICITLY to css:fill above. The prefix convention would resolve it to css:color, which is FALSE — this block never emits a CSS `color` declaration for the star; render.php:227/244 writes fill="..." as an SVG presentation attribute (see this file's header, render.php:7-8). The convention is a guess, and /sgs-update deliberately refuses to seed css_property from it (extract-signatures.py:2502), so before this mapping the DB held NULL and every DB-reading consumer (survey.js, rule 31, the cloning pipeline) was blind to it. emptyColour is a real but separate scalar (the unfilled-star fill) with no member of its own — an honest orphan mirroring sgs/icon-list's iconSize pattern. No font-size/weight/line-height surface — an SVG star has no typography.

star-empty.label: Star (unfilled)
star-empty._note_prefix: prefix "" is the documented explicit opt-out from orphan-scanning (findOrphans: `if ( prefix === '' ) continue`), same as sgs/business-info's `link` element. Required here because emptyColour IS claimed — by the explicit css:fill attrMap entry below — but the gate cannot see that claim: css:fill is declared appliesToLayers:["OUTER"] in cluster-member-sets.json (its suffixes are ShapeDividerTop/BottomColour), so memberAppliesToElement() skips it on a leaf element and it is never enumerated, never added to claimedAttrs. Without this opt-out the scan reports a style-defect orphan for an attribute that is correctly mapped — a FALSE POSITIVE, not an unaddressed control. Verified: /sgs-update Stage 1 reads attrMap directly (not via cluster enumeration) and derives css_property=fill, css_element=star-empty. RESIDUAL: whether css:fill should be widened from an OUTER shape-divider member to a general SVG-glyph paint member is a shared-vocabulary decision, deliberately not taken here.
star-empty._note: The UNFILLED star glyph — a separate <svg><path fill="…"> written by the same loop (render.php:222 `$fill = $empty_colour;`, and the second <stop> of the half-star linearGradient at render.php:217). Its own element rather than a member of `star` because one element cannot carry two `css:fill` mappings and emptyColour paints a genuinely different node from starColour. NEITHER node carries a CSS class — `fill` is written as a per-instance SVG PRESENTATION ATTRIBUTE, not a CSS rule — so this entry declares ownership of the VALUE exactly as `star` does; it is not a CSS-selector claim. prefix "empty" matches the attribute's real name. The attribute is deliberately NOT renamed to starEmptyColour: attribute names are the caller's, and WP silently discards an undeclared attr (D338), so a rename that missed one authoring would be invisible until a client's colour vanished.
